summary: Revised implementation plan for Prayer Focus UI/UX redesign, featuring custom emerald crescent and golden star extension icons (16x16, 48x48, 128x128), desktop sidebar with 10 dedicated sections, mobile drawer navigation, redesigned compact popup with live/cached/unavailable status, Light/Dark/System theme system, Quran reading stopwatch, categorized settings, and a GitHub Actions workflow YAML to package and release extension ZIPs automatically on push.
